player_prompt.intro:
Ndiwe Mchezaji {player_id} ({role}) m'chigwirizano cha Matching Pennies cha mizungu {num_rounds}.
- Mzunguko uliwonse, tumiza [heads] kapena [tails] (kapena [h], [t]).
- Ngati chaguo chako chimakhazikana na la mpinzako, Mchezaji 0 akupambana mzunguko; wapachina Mchezaji 1 akupambana.
Mwombe chaguo chako m'fomu ya '[heads]' kapena '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Mchezaji 0 anagwira {choice0}; Mchezaji 1 anagwira {choice1}. Khazikana -> Mchezaji 0 akupambana
message.round_mismatch: Mchezaji 0 anagwira {choice0}; Mchezaji 1 anagwira {choice1}. Osakhazikana -> Mchezaji 1 akupambana.

outcome.p0_wins: Munthu uyo wali na nambala 0 ndiyo wakathereska.
outcome.p1_wins: Munthu wakwamba ndiyo wakawina viphalizgano vinandi.
